title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
**Lead Software Engineer, Foundational APIs**
---------------------------------------------

**Location: Noida, India**

**WHAT MAKES US, US**
---------------------

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, and collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn, and pursue meaningful outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say hello to SimCorp!


At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values: Caring, Customer success\-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people\-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.


If you like what we are saying, keep reading!  



  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
------------------------------------

SimCorp is establishing a Foundational APIs capability to make core business data and functionality easier to access securely, consistently, and reliably across our products and solutions.  



  

As a Lead Software Engineer, you will help turn this ambition into working software. You will design and build API capabilities that support product experiences, integrations, workflows, clients, and approved AI solutions without requiring consumers to understand the complexity of SimCorp’s underlying systems.  



  

You will be a senior, hands\-on member of a newly established engineering team in India. You will help the team deliver its first production capabilities, establish effective engineering practices, and make sound implementation decisions across API design, distributed systems, security, reliability, testing, and cloud engineering.  



  

The role requires strong technical depth and practical delivery experience. You will contribute directly to the codebase while guiding other engineers through design discussions, reviews, problem solving, and continuous improvement.


You will collaborate with architects, Product Management, domain experts, Platform teams, and engineers across SimCorp to build capabilities that are valuable today and sustainable as the wider platform evolves.  



  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**
------------------------------------

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate secure and reliable Foundational API services using C\#/.NET and Microsoft Azure.
* Translate business and consumer requirements into clear API contracts, technical designs, and incremental implementation plans.
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership through coding, design discussions, code reviews, pairing, testing, and production problem resolution.
* Build API capabilities around clear business use cases rather than exposing the complexity of underlying systems and legacy implementations.
* Work with domain experts to understand the business meaning of concepts such as portfolios, positions, transactions, cash, instruments, and settlement information.
* Address distributed\-system concerns including latency, partial failure, retries, idempotency, concurrency, resilience, and source\-system availability.
* Build scalable and maintainable backend services with appropriate performance, security, and reliability characteristics.
* Assess and reuse existing API frameworks, gateways, integration solutions, domain services, and supported interfaces before introducing new abstractions.
* Create adapters and service components that separate stable consumer contracts from legacy or changing underlying implementations.
* Support the incremental modernization of existing systems without disrupting current consumers and business processes.
* Establish and promote effective engineering practices covering clean code, automated testing, contract testing, secure development, observability, CI/CD, and operational readiness.
* Build comprehensive automated tests across unit, integration, API, contract, and end\-to\-end levels where appropriate.
* Help define quality controls for API changes, including compatibility, versioning, documentation, security, and production readiness.
* Diagnose performance bottlenecks, production issues, integration failures, and complex defects, and implement sustainable solutions.
* Break complex engineering problems into focused, testable, and releasable increments.
* Collaborate with the Principal Software Engineer and architects on significant technical decisions and convert agreed direction into practical implementation.
* Mentor engineers through technical planning, code reviews, pairing, knowledge sharing, and constructive feedback.
* Promote shared technical ownership and help the team avoid dependency on individual specialists.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Platform, Architecture, Security, Data, and domain engineering teams to deliver integrated capabilities.
* Communicate technical decisions, assumptions, risks, dependencies, and limitations clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Continuously improve yourself, the team, our engineering practices, and the Foundational APIs capability.

**WHAT WE VALUE**
-----------------

Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing to and thriving in this role. We expect you to have strong expertise in several of the areas below, together with the willingness and curiosity to develop in the others.


* More than five years of professional software engineering experience.
* Strong programming experience in **C\# and .NET** , with a good understanding of clean, maintainable, and testable code.
* Practical experience designing and developing **REST APIs** , backend services, and system integrations.
* Experience with **Microsoft Azure** , Azure DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and production deployment.
* Experience creating and maintaining **CI/CD pipelines** and automated quality controls.
* Strong understanding of API design principles, including contracts, resource modelling, versioning, backward compatibility, pagination, filtering, and error handling.
* Experience designing secure backend systems using authentication, authorization, identity, access control, and secrets management.
* Understanding of distributed\-system concerns such as latency, resilience, concurrency, partial failure, consistency, idempotency, and safe retries.
* Strong automated\-testing skills, including unit, integration, API, contract, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Experience with observability practices including structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, health monitoring, and operational diagnostics.
* Experience with relational databases and SQL.
* Familiarity with messaging, event\-driven architecture, service bus patterns, or streaming technologies is valuable.
* Experience with Domain\-Driven Design or similar approaches to defining business capabilities and service boundaries is valuable.
* Experience working with legacy systems, modernization initiatives, adapters, or incremental migration is valuable.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to simplify complex technical problems and create maintainable solutions without introducing unnecessary abstraction.
* Ability to balance immediate delivery needs with security, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term contract stability.
* Experience mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence through practical guidance and collaboration.
* A continuous\-improvement mindset and experience working in an agile engineering environment.
* Experience collaborating in an international product\-development organization.
* Strong communication skills and fluency in English, both written and spoken.
* A degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, or a related field is valuable, but practical engineering experience and demonstrated capability are equally important.
* Interest in learning the investment\-management domain and understanding the business meaning behind the capabilities being developed.
* Readiness to learn relevant SimCorp technologies, frameworks, and legacy environments where required.

**AI\-ENABLED DEVELOPMENT**
---------------------------

* Use approved AI tools as part of everyday engineering, development, testing, documentation, and technical\-discovery workflows.
* Critically evaluate AI\-generated code, tests, designs, and documentation for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural fit.
* Help engineers understand when AI can accelerate delivery and when deeper engineering judgment and review are required.
* Identify opportunities where AI\-assisted development can accelerate prototyping, reduce repetitive work, strengthen testing, and improve developer productivity.
* Ensure that AI\-generated artifacts meet the same engineering, security, testing, and review standards as other contributions.

**FURTHERMORE, WE VALUE THAT YOU**
----------------------------------

* Take ownership from technical discovery through implementation, deployment, and production operation.
* Are curious about complex business and technical problems and seek to understand the context before proposing solutions.
* Can work effectively when business knowledge, implementation ownership, and technical dependencies are distributed across different teams.
* Are comfortable challenging assumptions constructively and changing direction when evidence supports a better approach.
* Lead through practical engineering contribution rather than relying on title or authority.
* Create a collaborative environment where engineers can raise concerns, explore alternatives, and learn from successes and failures.
* Identify technical debt and architectural risks and help the team address them deliberately.
* Focus on delivering the smallest useful capability that can be validated with a real consumer.
* Combine strong technical judgment with humility, openness, and respect for the expertise of others.

**BENEFITS**
------------

* **Global hybrid work policy:** We ask you to work two days a week from the office. You may work remotely on the other days, or work from the office if that is your preference.
* **Culture:** An inclusive and diverse company culture where different perspectives and expertise are valued.
* **Work\-life balance:** We believe that a sustainable balance between professional and personal responsibilities helps everyone perform at their best.
* **Empowerment:** We believe all voices are valuable and should be heard. You will be involved in shaping our technical direction and ways of working.
* **Career and growth:** SimCorp offers opportunities for professional development and supports individual career paths based on your strengths and aspirations.
* **Innovation:** You will have opportunities to contribute to engineering improvements, modernization, and strategic capabilities with impact across SimCorp.

**NEXT STEPS**
--------------

Please send us your application in English through our career site as soon as possible. We assess incoming applications continuously, and only applications submitted through our system can be processed.


At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur during recruitment. To support fairness and equal opportunity for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal information such as photographs, age, or other non\-professional details from your application.


If you are interested in joining SimCorp but are unsure whether this role is the right fit, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to help you identify suitable opportunities.


We continuously seek to improve our talent\-acquisition process and make every candidate’s experience positive and valuable. During the process, we may ask you to provide feedback, which will be highly appreciated.  

  



**WHO WE ARE**
--------------

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a leading provider of integrated investment\-management solutions. Our colleagues represent a broad range of nationalities, educational backgrounds, professional experiences, and perspectives.


SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of Deutsche Börse Group. Following the merger with Axioma, we combine the strengths of our brands to provide an industry\-leading, full front\-to\-back offering for our clients.


SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other status protected under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work.


We believe in the continuous growth and development of our employees so that we can provide best\-in\-class solutions to our clients.
